values.sim.assume.label: 1 if any event in the bundle is truly malicious (attack_linked, attack_single, mixed_unlinked), else 0
values.sim.assume.attack_linked: 2-3 malicious events on different channels, shared identity, gaps ~ Exponential(mean 15 min); each event's identity observed with prob 0.85
values.sim.assume.benign_linked: 2-3 benign events on different channels, shared identity, gaps Exponential with mean 30 min (50%) or 6 h (50%)
values.sim.assume.unlinked_bundles: events with distinct identities, times uniform over 72 h; with prob 0.08 a spurious shared identity is added
values.sim.assume.scores: each event gets the real held-out score of a randomly drawn real message of the right class and channel

open_defects.proposal: Proposed: accept because no case in S-01, S-02 or S-11 can show a lift (each already alerts alone), and the lift is shown instead by TC-06 against TC-07. This stays a hand-written and simulated result until real bundles exist (R2-10).

Proposed: accept because the alert does not change in S-06, and lowering a lone high score next to benign events is where the model's lower false-alarm rate on simulated bundles comes from. Recheck on real bundles (R2-10).
